# Vendored: aws-architecture-diagram-skill

Source: https://github.com/vidanov/aws-architecture-diagram-skill (MIT).
Vendored here so `animated-deck-builder` is self-contained: the deck builder
delegates AWS `.drawio` generation to this catalog instead of guessing stencil
names. Read `SKILL.md` here before generating a diagram; use `references/` for
the verified 270+ icon names. Upstream is the source of truth for updates.
